positions.name: MissingIdAcceptanceCriteria
positions.frame: what must the derive-id pipeline guarantee when a markdown heading arrives without an id field?
positions.why: src-1 names the concrete failure being reproduced — a ## heading with no id field from production — and src-2 sets the two non-negotiable constraints the pipeline must meet: no crash, valid slug output. Both expressions share a competence-directed negative valence (one calmly diagnosing the defect, the other urgently demanding its prevention), and together they span the problem-to-requirement arc: what is broken, and what counts as fixed. The conviction gradient — src-1 a settled claim about what exists, src-2 an operational decision about what must hold — is the tension the frame holds rather than resolves.
